# Uditha Manohara Prasad

> Uditha Manohara Prasad (also known as Uditha Manohara) is a Sri Lankan Software Engineer based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, and the Founder & CEO of Neziora (formerly Neziora Solutions). He is completing a BSc (Hons) in Software Engineering, builds reliable full-stack software made to last, and works as a professional freelancer. Building what's next.

## Quick facts

## Neziora
Neziora (formerly Neziora Solutions) is a technology brand built around the future, founded by Uditha Manohara Prasad. Tagline: "Building what's next." Beliefs: Knowledge (know your craft), Vision (look ahead), Connection (bring both together). Vision: to build technology the world can depend on.
- WhatsApp: +94 72 654 5635

## Services
Freelance software engineering for individuals, startups and small businesses: responsive business websites, full-stack web applications, and improvements to existing websites.

## Selected projects
- [SecureShield](https://shield-platform.web.app/): A centralized platform designed to bring privacy, recovery, verification, monitoring and digital-safety services together under one account.
- [Neziora LeadFlow](https://neziora-leadflow.netlify.app/): A customer-workflow platform for service businesses, connecting inquiries, follow-ups, quotations, customers and active jobs in one private workspace.
- [MindSprint](https://mindsprintlk.vercel.app/): A study-oriented platform engineered for focused work, personal study sessions and progress that can be synchronized through a Google account.
- [Crestline Graphics](https://crestlinegraphics.com/): A visually distinctive web system for a graphics agency, combining brand presentation, selected work, project enquiries and authenticated client-facing workflows.
- UMP Singlish: a Singlish-to-Sinhala Unicode conversion tool (https://github.com/uditha-manohara)

## Frequently asked
### Who is Uditha Manohara Prasad?
Uditha Manohara Prasad, also known as Uditha Manohara, is a Sri Lankan Software Engineer based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, and the Founder & CEO of Neziora. He is completing a BSc (Hons) in Software Engineering, builds reliable full-stack software made to last, and works as a professional freelancer. His approach: study the people, the process and the result first, then choose the technology that fits.

### What is Neziora?
Neziora is a technology brand founded by Uditha Manohara Prasad and built around the future. Its tagline is “Building what’s next.” It stands on three beliefs: Knowledge, Vision and Connection, and its vision is to build technology the world can depend on.

### Is Neziora the same as Neziora Solutions?
Yes. Neziora was previously known as Neziora Solutions. The brand now operates simply as Neziora, with the tagline “Building what’s next.”

### What services does Uditha Manohara Prasad offer?
Freelance software engineering for individuals, startups and small businesses: responsive business websites, full-stack web applications, and improvements to existing websites, delivered with a clear scope, a realistic plan and direct communication.

### What has Uditha Manohara Prasad built?
Selected projects include SecureShield (a digital-safety platform in development), Neziora LeadFlow (a lead, quotation and job-management platform), MindSprint (a study-focus platform with an AI quiz generator), the Crestline Graphics web system, and UMP Singlish, a Singlish-to-Sinhala Unicode converter.
